Oakfield offers a variety of luxurious A-rated homes that have been carefully considered with all buyers' needs in mind, making it easy for those to make this life change decision. Introducing No. 10 Bayview Crescent, a beautifully presented three-bedroom family home offering stylish contemporary accommodation, a generous rear garden and the added benefit of a downstairs WC. Bayview uniquely enjoys pedestrian access onto Killiney Beach from within the development, ideal for scenic coastal walks, sea swimming while Killiney DART Station is also within easy walking distance via a residents' shortcut to Seafield Road.

Internally, the accommodation comprises of entrance hall with storage and downstairs w.c., living room with a feature gas fire with stone surround and a bespoke built in window seat with hidden storage. The kitchen / dining room is open plan off the living and comprises of a stunning made to measure kitchen with sleek cabinetry, a large centre island unit and a range of integrated appliances and additional storage.

Upstairs, there are two spacious double bedrooms flooded with natural light, a well-proportioned third bedroom with built-in storage, a landing with hot press and a recently upgraded family bathroom.

The rear garden is larger than average, low maintenance in design and laid out with astro lawn, securely enclosed by fencing and a block-built wall. Side access links the front and rear gardens. To the front, there is off-street parking together with fitted hot and cold outdoor taps. The property also offers scope to extend further subject to the necessary planning permission.

Bayview is a highly regarded and family-friendly development with extensive green spaces and direct pedestrian access to Killiney Beach. Local amenities and activities abound, from sea swimming and paddleboarding at White Rock and The Vico to scenic walks and cycling routes across Killiney and Dalkey Hills, offering spectacular views over Dublin Bay. For sailing enthusiasts, the yacht clubs of Dun Laoghaire are within easy reach. Killiney DART Station is a short stroll away, while the villages of Dalkey, Killiney and Shankill offer an excellent selection of shops, cafés and restaurants. The area is also renowned for its excellent schools and enjoys convenient access to the N11, M50 and LUAS at Cherrywood, providing easy connectivity to the city centre and beyond. 101c21dd0f.description:
DNG Greystones is delighted to present No. 92 Archers Wood Avenue to the market. This attractive three-bedroom home offers a wonderful opportunity for buyers seeking a modern, turnkey property in a highly regarded development. Whether you are taking your first step onto the property ladder, moving to accommodate a growing family or looking to downsize without compromising on quality, this well-appointed home is sure to appeal.
Built by Cairn Homes in c. 2021, the property extends to approximately 119 Sq M and has been maintained to a high standard throughout. The accommodation is complemented by a private, sunny westerly-facing rear garden and a generous ready to convert attic space offering excellent potential for conversion.
The beautifully appointed accommodation comprises:
Entrance Hall. A welcoming entrance hall featuring attractive laminate wood flooring, which continues into the living room and kitchen/dining area to create a sense of continuity throughout the ground floor. A guest WC and separate cloakroom provide valuable everyday convenience, with practical storage for coats and shoes.
Living Room. A bright and spacious reception room with ample room for two sofas and additional seating within the bay window. Picture-frame wall moulding adds an elegant decorative touch, giving the room a refined and inviting feel.
Kitchen/Dining Room. The kitchen and dining area is thoughtfully designed, with an excellent range of fitted storage units, integrated Neff appliances and a peninsula incorporating seating. Stone worktops provide generous preparation space, while a window and French doors allow natural light to fill the room and create a seamless connection with the rear garden.
Utility Room. A useful addition to the ground floor, offering further shelved storage and plumbing for a washing machine.
Landing. Carpeted stairs lead to the first-floor landing, which provides access to three bedrooms, the hot press and the attic via a Stira pull-down ladder.
Bedroom 1. The principal bedroom is positioned to the front of the property and benefits from excellent wardrobe space. Two windows enhance the natural light, creating a bright and comfortable retreat.
En-Suite. The en-suite shower room is finished with contemporary wall and floor tiling and comprises a large shower unit, WC and WHB.
Bedroom 2. A generous double bedroom overlooking the rear garden, complete with fitted wardrobes and ample space for a desk or dedicated workspace.
Bedroom 3. A well-proportioned single bedroom, also enjoying a pleasant outlook over the rear garden, with sufficient room for a bed and home office desk.
Bathroom. The family bathroom is finished with modern wall and floor tiling and comprises a bath, separate shower cubicle, WC and WHB.
Externally, the front of the property provides off-street parking for 2 cars on a cobble-lock driveway, complemented by mature shrubs and a fitted bin store. To the rear, the private garden enjoys a desirable westerly aspect, capturing the afternoon and evening sunshine. Extending to approximately 12.75m in length, it offers an appealing outdoor space for relaxation and entertaining, while also presenting potential for a garden cabin or an extension to the existing accommodation, subject to the necessary permissions.
Archers Wood is a particularly attractive development, with residents enjoying access to approximately 20 acres of landscaped green spaces, incorporating two playgrounds, a sports pitch and winding walking paths. The nearby Three Trout's Way, a scenic greenway connecting Delgany and Greystones, provides an additional opportunity to enjoy the surrounding countryside. Thoughtful landscaping, wildflower meadows and established wooded areas also contribute to the development's natural character and biodiversity.
The location is exceptionally convenient, with both Delgany and Greystones close by, offering an excellent selection of shops, boutiques, pharmacies, butchers, cafés and restaurants. The Eden Gate Shopping Centre is approximately 550m away, while Delgany Village is 1.2km and Charlesland 1.8km from the property. Families are well catered for, with several creches and primary schools in the locality, including Delgany National School (1.7km), St Laurence's National School (2.5km) and Greystones Community National School (1.6km). Both St David's Secondary School and Temple Carrig School are within approximately 4km.
For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the wider Wicklow area offers an extensive choice of sporting clubs, outdoor pursuits and leisure facilities, many within a 5km radius. Commuters benefit from convenient access to the N11 via Delgany Village or Farrankelly Road, while Dublin Bus services operate along Kilcoole Road between Archers Wood and Glenheron. Greystones DART station is approximately 3.1km away on foot or 3.7km by car.
With its modern construction, well-planned accommodation, sunny rear garden and convenient location, No. 92 Archers Wood Avenue represents an appealing opportunity to acquire a home that is ready for immediate occupation in a popular residential development. A personal inspection is highly recommended.

Situated within the much sought-after Charlesland development in Greystones, this beautifully presented two-bedroomed terraced home has been cleverly enhanced by an attic conversion and a spacious open-plan kitchen/dining room overlooking a private, low-maintenance back garden.
Well-maintained and presented in excellent condition throughout, the property combines bright and well-proportioned living accommodation with a highly convenient location close to a neighbourhood shopping centre and within easy reach of the many shops, schools, services and recreational amenities the wider Greystones area has to offer.

At the heart of the home is a spacious and light-filled open-plan kitchen/dining room extending across the full width of the property to the rear. This inviting living space features a contemporary fitted kitchen with Shaker-style cabinets, contrasting worktops and integrated appliances, while the adjoining dining area has ample room for a family-sized dining table.

French doors with glazed side panels open directly from the dining area onto the back garden patio, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living and making this an ideal space for entertaining friends and family.

To the front of the house is a comfortably proportioned living room overlooking the front driveway. Presented in a tasteful neutral colour scheme, this welcoming room features attractive wood-effect flooring, while a large window allows natural light to flood into the space.
An internal hallway with stairs leading to the first floor and a well-appointed guest bathroom complete the downstairs accommodation.
Upstairs are two good-sized bedrooms, both with fitted wardrobes, a landing with hot press directly off and a beautifully finished contemporary family bathroom.

The bathroom has been stylishly modernised with floor-to-ceiling tiling, a walk-in shower enclosure with glass screen, a rainfall showerhead, a contemporary wash hand basin and an illuminated feature mirror. Contrasting textured wall tiles add a further touch of style to this well-appointed space.

A particular feature of this property is its converted attic, accessed by a permanent staircase from the first floor. This bright and versatile additional space is currently laid out as a bedroom and benefits from three roof windows, recessed ceiling lighting and useful under-eaves storage. Offering flexibility to suit a variety of requirements, it could equally serve as a home office, study, hobby room or occasional guest accommodation.
The property's appeal is further enhanced by a variety of attractive features, including contemporary flooring, tasteful décor, fitted bedroom wardrobes and a modern kitchen and bathroom, all combining to create a comfortable and inviting home.
Outside, there are low-maintenance gardens to the front and rear. Set out in cobble lock, the front driveway provides convenient off-street parking and is equipped with an electric vehicle charging point.

To the rear, the fully enclosed back garden has been designed with ease of maintenance in mind. Featuring a paved patio and a further hardstanding area, this private outdoor space is ideal for barbecues, outdoor dining or simply relaxing on fine days. A timber garden building at the end of the garden provides valuable additional space, while painted timber boundary fencing creates a neat and attractive finish.
With its flexible accommodation, converted attic, contemporary interiors and convenient location, Number 65 Charlesland Court is an ideal choice for first-time buyers, couples, young families and those seeking a modern home within easy reach of Greystones town centre.
Call us today to arrange a viewing of this must-see property.

LOCATION
Charlesland is a popular and well-established residential development on the southern outskirts of Greystones, renowned for its attractive landscaped surroundings, extensive amenity greens and family-friendly environment.
The development features numerous open green spaces, mature trees, planting areas, a children's playground and nearby parkland with inviting walks and trails, making it a particularly appealing setting for families and outdoor enthusiasts.
Number 65 Charlesland Court is conveniently situated within easy reach of the Charlesland neighbourhood shopping centre, which includes a large SuperValu supermarket, pharmacy, hair and beauty salon, takeaway and fitness facilities.
The property is also within easy reach of Greystones town centre, with its bustling array of supermarkets, shops, boutiques, stores and other retail outlets, along with the excellent selection of pubs, cafés, bistros, restaurants and amenities that make the town such a popular lifestyle choice.
The wider Greystones area is home to a variety of sports clubs catering for soccer, rugby, GAA, golf, tennis, sailing, cricket and rowing, while popular local leisure amenities include Greystones Marina, the Shoreline Leisure Centre, the town's beaches and picturesque seafront walks. The nearby Wicklow Mountains also offer an extensive choice of scenic trails and outdoor pursuits.
An excellent selection of local schools includes Greystones Community National School, situated beside the Charlesland development, along with Delgany National School, Gaelscoil na gCloch Liath, St. Kevin's, St. Patrick's, St. Brigid's and St. Laurence's national schools. Nearby secondary schools include Temple Carrig, St. David's Holy Faith and Greystones Community College. There is also a good choice of pre-school and Montessori facilities.
For commuters, Charlesland is well positioned to access the N11/M11 road network, providing convenient connections to Dublin, the M50 and other east coast destinations. Greystones DART station offers regular rail services to Dublin city centre and beyond, while the area is also served by local bus routes.

Combining the convenience of modern suburban living with easy access to the coast, countryside and bustling town centre, Charlesland continues to be one of the most popular residential locations in the greater Greystones area.

3ae4516b26.description:
No. 5 Cedar Court is a beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home, ideally positioned within Churchfields, a quiet and highly regarded enclave of Delgany Wood. Experiencing the best of coastline and countryside living, residents enjoy local access to walking trails & the Sugar Loaf, as well as the beach at Greystones and convenient access to the charming Delgany Village. With light and comfort in abundance, this wonderful home extends to 113.9 sq m / 1,226 sq ft approx. and benefits from a B Energy Rating and an impressive extension to the rear, offering bright and thoughtfully arranged accommodation with contemporary finishes and a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. This home has been lovingly maintained by the current owners throughout the years and enhanced to make the most of the available space and its attractive surroundings. Enjoying a sunny southwest-facing garden capturing afternoon and evening sunshine, this is a versatile home which truly caters to a wide variety of buyers and is certain to appeal to first-time buyers or indeed those who are right-sizing. 

The internal accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming hallway decorated with stylish wall panelling, giving access to understairs storage and a convenient guest WC. To the front, the living room is a cosy and inviting reception room, with a box bay window overlooking the front drive, allowing an abundance of natural light to fill the room. To the rear lies the kitchen / dining room, fitted with a range of eye and floor-level cabinetry and a central island to provide valuable additional storage and preparation space. Beyond the kitchen, the extended family room is a standout feature of the home. Floor-to-ceiling dual-aspect windows as well as an overhead Velux window with built-in rain sensor flood the room with natural light, whilst framing a pleasant outlook of the outdoor space. Sliding doors open directly onto the southwest-facing rear garden. Upstairs, the principal bedroom is a spacious double room positioned to the front, overlooking Churchfields through a box bay window. The adjoining en-suite shower room is finished with floor-to-ceiling tiling and built-in shelving. The second bedroom is another generous double room, overlooking the rear garden and enjoying attractive views towards the surrounding hills. A third bedroom to the front, together with a well-appointed family bathroom, completes the first-floor accommodation.

Outside, the private southwest-facing rear garden is finished with raised planter beds and attractive composite decking, where one can enjoy a tranquil outdoor oasis with a direct view out to the well-known Drummin Trees landmark in Delgany. Extensively upgraded and meticulously maintained — including being fully repainted and fitted with new blinds throughout in September 2025 — the property is presented in true walk-in condition. Welcome to Kilternan Village by Durkan New Homes

Durkan New Homes are very pleased to share details on their newest development, nestled at the foothills of the breathtaking Dublin Mountains, Kilternan Village is more than just a development—it's a vision for a vibrant and sustainable community where people can gather, interact, and thrive. Hamilton Park – Exceptional A3-Rated Three-Bedroom Semi-Detached Home with Large Garden
Property Overview
An exceptional double-fronted, three-bedroom semi-detached home built in 2017, ideally situated on Diswellstown Way in the highly sought-after Hamilton Park development. This beautifully presented property combines a practical, well-planned layout with generous outdoor space, excellent storage and impressive energy-efficiency features.
A particular highlight is the large east-facing rear garden and patio, providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and relaxation. Inside, the bright dual-aspect living room, spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area, separate utility room and excellent storage make this an appealing home for modern family living.
The property also benefits from an A3 Building Energy Rating (BER), insulation, triple-glazed Rational windows with security locks, solar thermal panels and a mechanical ventilation system. These features help retain heat, maintain indoor comfort and reduce energy consumption, with the solar thermal system helping to reduce reliance on gas for hot water.
An additional advantage is the spacious, unconverted attic with a floored storage area and Stira access. This offers generous storage and potential for alternative uses, subject to feasibility and any necessary planning permissions, building regulations and other approvals.
Accommodation
Ground Floor
The welcoming entrance hall features laminate flooring and a convenient guest WC with tiled flooring and partially tiled walls. An understairs storage room with fitted shelving provides valuable additional space for household essentials.
To the right of the hallway, the bright dual-aspect living room enjoys natural light from two sides. Laminate flooring and double doors opening onto the rear garden create a welcoming living space that connects naturally with the outdoor area.
To the left, the spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area features three windows, allowing plenty of natural light. The L-shaped kitchen, designed by Nolans Kitchens, is fully integrated and offers a gas hob together with generous countertop and cupboard space. The combination of laminate and tiled flooring adds practicality to this versatile space, which is well suited to everyday family life and entertaining.
A separate utility room, accessed directly from the kitchen, provides additional functionality with tiled flooring, built-in storage and wall-mounted shelving. Its direct access to the garden is a particularly practical feature, while side access connects the rear garden to the front of the property.
First Floor
The first floor comprises three west-facing bedrooms, all featuring laminate flooring and sophisticated fitted wardrobes.
The master bedroom benefits from a stylish ensuite with tiled flooring, a towel radiator and wall-mounted storage.
The family bathroom is generously proportioned and features a separate bath and shower, a towel radiator, built-in storage and high-specification sanitary ware.
The landing includes the hot press and a window overlooking the rear garden. It also provides access via a Stira staircase to the spacious, floored attic area.
Attic and Additional Storage
The large, unconverted attic is an important additional feature of the property. With a generous floored area and convenient Stira access, it provides substantial storage capacity beyond the accommodation on the two main floors.
The attic may offer potential for other uses, subject to its dimensions, headroom, structural suitability, building regulations, planning requirements and any other necessary approvals. Its existing storage capacity and potential should be considered when assessing the property's overall appeal and value, while recognising that no conversion is currently represented as completed or approved.
Garden and Outdoor Space
The large east-facing rear garden and patio are among the property's standout features. Offering generous outdoor space, the garden is ideal for enjoying the morning and daytime sunshine, outdoor dining, entertaining guests or simply relaxing.
Double doors from the dual-aspect living room create a natural connection between indoor and outdoor living. Direct garden access from the separate utility room and side access to the front of the house add further everyday convenience.
To the front, the property features an attractive partial-brick façade, a front garden and a cobblelock driveway providing parking for two cars.
Energy Efficiency and Key Features
The property combines modern construction with a range of features designed to support energy efficiency, thermal comfort and security.
•	A3 Building Energy Rating: A strong energy-performance rating that can be attractive to buyers seeking an energy-efficient home.
•	Insulation: Helps reduce heat loss and maintain a more comfortable indoor temperature.
•	Rational triple-glazed windows with security locks: Help improve heat retention, reduce cold draughts and provide additional security.
•	Solar thermal panels: Use solar energy to heat domestic hot water, helping reduce the amount of gas required for water heating, depending on weather, usage and system performance.
•	Mechanical ventilation system: Supports ventilation and indoor air quality while helping manage moisture and condensation.
•	Large east-facing garden and patio: Generous outdoor space for relaxation and entertaining.
•	Bright dual-aspect living room: Natural light from two sides and direct access to the garden.
•	Open-plan kitchen and dining area: A spacious, practical setting for family life.
•	Separate utility room: Additional storage, laundry space and convenient garden access.
•	Excellent storage: Includes fitted bedroom wardrobes, understairs storage, built-in bathroom storage and a large floored attic.
•	Parking for two cars: Cobblelock driveway to the front of the property.
•	Built in 2017: Modern construction and contemporary family accommodation.
Together, these features offer a combination of comfort, practicality, security and energy efficiency that deserves prominence in the property's marketing.
Location
Diswellstown Way is ideally positioned within Hamilton Park, a popular residential development with access to local schools, sports clubs, parks and playgrounds.
Families will appreciate the proximity to St Patrick’s National School and Castleknock Community College, alongside other educational facilities in the surrounding area.
Castleknock and Blanchardstown villages are both approximately a five-minute drive away, offering a wide choice of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants. Blanchardstown Shopping Centre provides further retail and leisure options, while the nearby Phoenix Park offers extensive green space for walking, cycling and outdoor recreation.
For commuters, Coolmine Train Station is a short walk away, providing rail connections towards Dublin city centre and other destinations. Local bus services are also readily accessible, with the 37 bus stopping just outside the estate.
The combination of local amenities, educational facilities, green spaces and public transport makes Hamilton Park a convenient location for families and commuters alike.
Key Property Details
•	Location: Diswellstown Way, Hamilton Park
•	Property type: Double-fronted semi-detached house
•	Bedrooms: Three
•	Year built: 2017
•	BER rating: A3
•	Garden: Large east-facing rear garden with patio
•	Parking: Cobblelock driveway with space for two cars
•	Living accommodation: Dual-aspect living room and open-plan kitchen/dining area
•	Additional facilities: Separate utility room, guest WC, ensuite and family bathroom
•	Storage: Understairs storage, fitted wardrobes and spacious floored attic
•	Energy features: Insulation, triple glazing, solar thermal panels and mechanical ventilation
A Home with Space, Efficiency and Additional Potential
This Hamilton Park property offers far more than well-presented three-bedroom accommodation. Its large east-facing garden and patio, bright dual-aspect living room, practical kitchen and utility layout, excellent storage and spacious attic combine to create a home with considerable everyday appeal.
The A3 energy rating and range of energy-efficiency features provide further advantages for buyers conscious of comfort and running costs. Meanwhile, the attic offers valuable existing storage and potential for alternative uses, subject to the relevant requirements.
With its convenient location close to schools, public transport, shopping facilities and recreational amenities, this is a well-equipped modern family home offering space, practicality and additional potential in a sought-after Hamilton Park setting. Year of construction 2017

Nestled within a mature and highly sought-after residential setting, No. 11 Somerton is a well-presented four-bedroom semi-detached family home offering bright and well-balanced accommodation together with off-street parking and a private, low-maintenance rear garden.

This attractive home has been carefully maintained and upgraded over the years, benefiting from a BER rating of B3, triple-glazed windows and a recently installed boiler, ensuring excellent energy efficiency and year-round comfort. The accommodation is ideally suited to modern family living, with spacious reception areas and a practical layout throughout. Of particular note is the second reception room, enhanced by a charming box bay window overlooking the rear garden, flooding the space with natural light and creating a wonderful setting for family gatherings, dining or relaxation.
Upstairs, the property comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms, including three generous double rooms and a comfortable single bedroom, all serviced by a family shower room. The bright and airy accommodation offers excellent versatility for growing families, those working from home, or anyone seeking additional guest accommodation.
Outside, the private rear garden enjoys a sunny and sheltered aspect and has been designed with ease of maintenance in mind. A garden shed provides valuable additional storage, while side access adds further practicality. To the front, there is off-street parking and a neat garden setting that complements the home's appealing kerb appeal.

The location is second to none, enjoying close proximity to Dún Laoghaire town centre and a wealth of local amenities. Residents can avail of an excellent selection of schools, including Monkstown Educate Together, Holy Family National School, Rathdown School, Clonkeen College and CBC Monkstown. There are numerous shops, cafés, restaurants, sporting facilities and parks nearby, while the coastal attractions of Dún Laoghaire, Sandycove and Monkstown are all within easy reach.
Transport links are excellent, with several Dublin Bus routes operating nearby and both Dún Laoghaire and Glenageary DART stations within convenient reach. The N11 and M50 road networks are also easily accessible, ensuring straightforward travel throughout Dublin and beyond.
Combining a desirable location, practical family accommodation and excellent connectivity, No. 11 Somerton presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a home in one of South Dublin's most established residential areas. 11 Somerton Entrance Hall - 2.74m x 1.76m

68990692ab.description:
8 Drinaghmore Close is a detached house at the end of a cul-de-sac opposite Leopardstown Valley Shopping Centre, less than 2 minutes walk from the LUAS station.It has wide side passages on both sides.

This house was custom built in 1999 on a freehold plot of land.It is attractively laid our with bright open-plan living spaces.It is well-presented, vacant and waiting for a new owner. Downstairs comes finished with brushed aluminium door handles and light switches, solid pine flooring, and frosted glass internal doors. It has a high-efficiency condensing gas boiler and vertical radiators in all downstairs rooms. It comes with good quality German triple-glazed windows to the front and matching double-glazed windows to rear. It has a C1 BER rating. This could easily be upgraded to a B rating by improving the attic insulation.

Accommodation consists of an entrance hall with under-stairs shoe storage and guest WC. Interconnecting reception rooms consisting of a front living room with box window and a rear open-plan kitchen/dining room with French doors to the back garden patio area and back lawn privately secluded behind mature shrubs and bamboo.The white high gloss fitted kitchen has high quality fitted appliances, all of which are included in the sale.The Smeg gas hob is located in the peninsula helping to connect with occupants in the room while cooking. It has a distinctive round wall-mounted extractor hood. Off the kitchen is a handy utility room which comes fitted with a washing machine, dryer and free-standing freezer. From here a back door opens to one of the two side passages. Upstairs there is a bright landing with window, a master bedroom with ensuite, a second generous double bedroom with mirrored wardrobes and a third box bedroom. The bathroom has a full-size bathtub, Triton electric shower, glass shower-screen and an oval lit and heated mirror. From the landing an attic hatch opens to a useful attic space.

To the front there is a spacious front garden with off-street parking for 3-4 cars. There are two wide side passages which could be covered for storing bikes / motorbikes or outside toys. The back garden has a tidy back lawn and an easterly facing patio area, privately screened by mature shrubs and bamboo.

Schools within a few minutes walk include Holy Trinity National School, Stepaside Educate Together Secondary School, Gaelscoil Shliabh Rua and Kilternan School of Music. Molloys/The Gallops sports pub and bar/grill is a highly regarded local, ideal for a car free evening out. The nearby Samuel Beckett Civic Centre has an abundance of additional sports facilities including GAA, Soccer, gym, astro pitches, planned swimming pool and a library.

A footbridge over the M50 leads to Leopardstown Racecourse, Westwood Sports Club/Gym/Tennis/Swimming, Leopardstown Golf Centre, and Nord Anglia International School, as well as the employment hubs (including Microsoft HQ) in South County Business Park, 

Nearby on Glencairn Green there is a playground, tennis courts, basketball court, exercise area and a large green play area. There are similar facilities across the road in Clay Farm. 

In addition to Leopardstown Valley Shopping Centre there is shopping nearby in the newly expanded Carrickmines Retail Park, Dunnes Stores Cornelscourt, Stillorgan Shopping Centre and Dundrum Town Centre.

6a0a6e8ccc.description:
With just two Four Bedroom Semi-Detached homes at Monaloe Grove, this is a rare and exclusive offering. With spacious, light-filled interiors and an open plan layout set across two storeys, this house type meets all the requirements of modern living. 

The 5 Bedroom & Study Home at Monaloe Grove comes in both Detached and Semi-Detached options. These large homes are amongst the finest and most generously proportioned new offerings to come to the market across South County Dublin in recent years, and viewing is highly recommended. 

MONALOE GROVE, CABINTEELY, DUBLIN 18
Contemporary family living in one of South Dublin’s most established addresses
Introducing Monaloe Grove, an exclusive new collection of spacious and luxurious family homes in Cabinteely, one of South Dublin's most prestigious and enduring residential addresses. Carefully conceived and thoughtfully designed, Monaloe Grove combines striking contemporary architecture, generous family-focused accommodation and exceptional craftsmanship to create a boutique development of genuine distinction. 

Nestled within a well-connected, mature and highly sought-after neighbourhood, Monaloe Grove offers an opportunity to acquire a substantial newly built home within a location already renowned for its reputation, character and quality of life. Monaloe Grove builds upon the strengths of an established community that has long been regarded as one of South Dublin's most desirable places to call home. 

The Homes
Just eleven. Individually considered. Designed for family life.
This exclusive collection comprises just eleven new homes, comprising of detached and semi-detached three, four and five-bedroom residences, with many incorporating dedicated study spaces and flexible accommodation designed to adapt to the evolving needs of modern family life. The limited scale of the development creates a natural sense of privacy and exclusivity, offering residents a boutique residential setting that feels intimate, established and enduring. 

Contemporary Design
Designed by DMVF Architects with longevity in mind, each home has been crafted to deliver exceptional levels of comfort, functionality and style. Spacious, light-filled interiors are enhanced by generous ceiling heights, expansive glazing and carefully considered layouts that maximise natural daylight throughout. Large open-plan kitchen, dining and family spaces form the heart of each home, creating environments that are equally suited to everyday family living and entertaining. 

The homes present a refined contemporary streetscape, combining warm brick elevations with crisp dark cladding, elegant full-height windows and carefully landscaped driveways to the front while private rear gardens feature attractive paved areas and lawns. This considered architectural approach creates an impressive sense of arrival, bringing together modern sophistication, strong kerb appeal and a welcoming residential character that sits comfortably within the established Cabinteely setting.

A-Rated Living
These A-rated new homes are designed for modern, energy-efficient living, incorporating air-to-water heat pump technology to help deliver year-round comfort, improved efficiency and lower day-to-day running costs. For homeowners, this means warmer, more comfortable interiors, a lighter environmental footprint and a home that supports a more convenient, sustainable and future-focused lifestyle.

Luxury Interiors
The interiors draw inspiration from the timeless contemporary aesthetic associated with Carton Interiors, creating elegant and welcoming homes that balance refinement with practicality. Hand crafted kitchens will provide a stunning focal point within each residence, complemented by a premium suite of Siemens integrated appliances and carefully selected finishes throughout. Every aspect of the homes has been considered to ensure a superior standard of modern family living.

Cabinteely & Beyond
Village life, coastline and city – all within easy reach
Everyday convenience and a vibrant local lifestyle are central to the appeal of Monaloe Grove, with an excellent choice of shopping, cafés, restaurants and bars within easy reach. Cabinteely Village provides a welcoming neighbourhood atmosphere for coffee, casual dining and day-to-day essentials, while nearby Foxrock, Cornelscourt, Stillorgan, Blackrock, Dalkey and Dún Laoghaire offer a broader selection of boutiques, specialist food stores, supermarkets, destination restaurants and coastal dining. From relaxed weekend brunches and evening meals to local shopping and socialising, residents will be exceptionally well placed to enjoy the established retail and hospitality offering of South Dublin.

Education
The area is particularly renowned for its exceptional educational offering. Many of Dublin's most respected primary and secondary schools are situated nearby and within easy reach by the very strong public transport connections immediately outside, including St Brigid’s Foxrock, Holly Park, Loreto Foxrock, Mount Anville, Blackrock College, St Andrew's College, Clonkeen College, St Michael’s and Gonzaga, while UCD Belfield is also directly connected from outside by the most frequently serviced bus corridor in Dublin.

Lifestyle
For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the surrounding area offers an abundance of recreational amenities, including Cabinteely Park, Kilbogget Park, Killiney Hill and Killiney Beach. The Dublin coastline and numerous golf, tennis, rugby, sailing and GAA clubs, offer further amenity. Whether enjoying a coastal walk, a morning coffee in Cabinteely Village or a round of golf at one of South Dublin's renowned clubs, residents will be perfectly positioned to enjoy the very best the area has to offer.

Exceptionally Connected
Excellent connectivity further enhances the appeal of Monaloe Grove. The N11, M50 and wider motorway network are all readily accessible, providing convenient connections to Dublin City Centre, Dublin Airport and beyond. The N11 Quality Bus Corridor is immediately alongside, providing Dublin’s strongest bus artery on your doorstep, with buses travelling on average every couple of minutes to/from Dublin City Centre at peak times. 

The Rock Road Quality Bus Corridor also connects outside Monaloe Grove, providing a very rare combination of two Quality Bus Corridors on your doorstep. Carrickmines and Cherrywood LUAS stops are within easy reach, further enhancing excellent public transport options for commuters and families alike.

A Rare Opportunity
Only eleven homes. One exceptional address.
Monaloe Grove represents a unique opportunity to secure a substantial new family home in an established, highly desirable location where opportunities of this nature are exceptionally scarce. Combining exclusivity, architectural quality and a setting already defined by its reputation, Monaloe Grove offers an exceptional standard of living within one of South Dublin's most sought-after and well connected residential communities.

33A Blackthorn Green is a beautifully presented three-bedroom family home extending to approximately 96 sq. m. / 1,033 sq. ft., ideally positioned within this highly sought-after residential setting in Sandyford. Built more recently than many of the surrounding homes and benefiting from modern construction standards, excellent insulation, gas-fired central heating and solar panels, the property offers stylish, energy-efficient accommodation perfectly suited to modern family living.

Beautifully maintained and upgraded by its current owners, the accommodation is laid out over three levels and provides a superb balance of living and bedroom space. Upon entering, a welcoming hallway leads to a spacious living room featuring a wood-burning stove, recessed lighting and double doors opening into the kitchen/dining room, creating an excellent flow between the principal living areas.

To the rear, the impressive open-plan kitchen/dining room forms the heart of the home. Overhead skylights and large glazed doors flood the room with natural light, while the contemporary Kube kitchen is fitted with quartz worktops and splashbacks together with a range of integrated appliances. Double doors provide seamless access to the rear garden, making the space ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining. A fully tiled wet room at ground floor level further enhances the practicality of the accommodation.

The first floor comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms and a stylish family bathroom. The principal bedroom benefits from fitted wardrobes, while all bedrooms enjoy excellent natural light and generous proportions.

A particular feature of the property is the converted attic room, extending the overall floor area to approximately 117 sq. m. / 1,259 sq. ft. While currently utilised as a bedroom by the current owners, the space is not included in the stated accommodation and is not compliant for use as a bedroom. Nevertheless, it provides valuable additional space together with eaves storage and a skylight and would be ideally suited to a home office, playroom, gym, hobby room or storage space.

Blackthorn Green is a mature and highly regarded development ideally positioned close to Ballawley Park, Dundrum Town Centre, the Beacon Hospital, the Beacon South Quarter and a host of local shops, cafés and restaurants. Families are particularly well catered for, with an excellent selection of primary and secondary schools nearby.

The location is exceptionally well connected, with Kilmacud Luas Stop less than a 10-minute walk away, numerous Dublin Bus routes serving the area and easy access to the M50 providing convenient connectivity throughout Dublin and beyond.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a modern and energy-efficient family home in one of South Dublin's most desirable residential locations, offering an ideal balance of style, space and convenience. Entrance Hall - 5.94m x 1.81m
Welcoming entrance hallway with tiled flooring, radiator and Bosch washing machine and dryer neatly concealed beneath the stairs.

Located in a mature, cul-de-sac, Maple is a highly desirable development situated just off the Laurel Lodge Road and would make an ideal, family home for first time buyers or indeed those trading up or downsizing in the area. 

Measuring 119 sq.m./1281 sq.ft. approx. No. 14 comprises of well-proportioned living space, which is in pristine condition throughout. At ground floor level is the entrance hall, with convenient under-stair storage and guest WC. The hallway leads through to the beautifully presented living room, with a feature, gas fireplace. Description:
Dating from circa 1840, Cúram House is a distinctive detached Gothic Revival residence occupying a mature setting of approximately 0.35 acres in the heart of Enniskerry. 

The house is notable for its prominent gabled elevations, decorative timber bargeboards and characterful entrance porch with a Tudor style arched opening, all contributing to its distinctive period character and presence.

Extending to c. 217.2 sq. m. / 2,338 sq. ft., the house offers substantial accommodation arranged over split levels, together with a detached garage and mature private grounds. 

The ground floor is arranged with two generous reception rooms at entrance level and the kitchen, dining room and bathroom to the lower ground floor. The boiler room is accessed externally from the garden.

The first floor offers four well proportioned bedrooms, together with a family bathroom and hot press, arranged over two levels.

Requiring comprehensive refurbishment, Cúram House presents an exciting opportunity to restore and reimagine a characterful period residence and/or develop the surplus site area (S.P.P) in one of Wicklow’s most sought-after villages.


Location:
Cúram House enjoys a prime position within Enniskerry Village, with an attractive selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and local amenities all within walking distance.

The surrounding area is renowned for its natural beauty with Powerscourt Estate, Powerscourt Gardens and the Wicklow Mountains all nearby, offering an abundance of recreational and outdoor pursuits.

Enniskerry also benefits from convenient access to Dublin City Centre and the wider road network via the N11/M11.

This beautifully presented two-bedroom home benefits from a number of notable upgrades, including a new combi boiler (c.2023) internal wall insulation to the front and rear walls (c.2025) , new doors and windows throughout (c.2023) , and a modernised kitchen (C.2023) and shower room. Ideally positioned within the ever-popular Charlesland development, the property enjoys a peaceful setting adjacent to two beautifully maintained green spaces, together with a sunny and private rear garden. The attic conversion provides an excellent additional room, equally suited to use as a home office, guest room or playroom, making this an appealing home for a variety of buyers.
The bright and well-proportioned accommodation begins with an inviting entrance porch, complete with tiled flooring. This leads through to the living room, where bespoke floor-to-ceiling cabinetry incorporates a fitted TV unit, providing an attractive and practical focal point.

Regular bus services and cycle paths provide easy access to Greystones village, with its excellent selection of shops, cafés and restaurants, together with the popular harbour and DART station.

7f2436e5bb.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen to acquire a substantial semi-detached family in the ever-popular Seacrest estate. No. 73 occupies a prime position within the development enjoying views towards Bray Head and the sea from the front bedrooms and further complemented with a lengthy west facing garden to the rear. Formerly a three-bedroom residence, planning was obtained and the footprint was enhanced with the addition of a garage conversion and extension above creating a fully compliant self-contained unit to the side. Combined, the total floor area spans 150 sq. m providing the discerning buyer with the option of incorporating the self-contained unit into the original house or retain the existing layouts and use the unit to the side for an accompanying parent or investment opportunity. 

The internal accommodation is extremely bright throughout and is scheduled over two floors. Entering the main house, the hallway comprises understairs storage and wood flooring which is a recurring theme in the large dual aspect living dining room off to the left and an open fireplace here serves as the main focal point. The kitchen sits to the rear overlooking the garden containing tiled flooring, a range of cabinetry, tiled splashback, and integrated appliances include an oven and gas hob. Upstairs, on the first floor there are three bedrooms, two double one single. The principal bedroom is positioned to front along with the single bedroom, and both enjoy pleasant views towards Bray Head and the sea. A fully tiled modern wet room off the landing completes the layout at this level. 

The self-contained unit or 73A as its officially known as measures 45 sq. m approx. and can be accessed from its own door entrance or via an inner hallway off the kitchen in the main house. Beyond the front door there is a carpeted hallway along with a WC beneath the stairs. Directly to the left there is a kitchen dining room, this clever compact space is complete with a range of base and eye level units. Rising upstairs, there is a large bedroom along with an en-suite shower room and walk in wardrobe. A vaulted ceiling provides a sense of space while the unobstructed views can also be enjoyed from the bay window. 

Externally, on approach, a driveway accommodates secure off-street parking. The main house and self-contained unit have their own separate entrances with steps leading to their respective hall doors. The front is screened by an abundance of mature planting and a lawn to the lefthand side while to the right, a gated side passage leads through to the private rear garden. It's also worth nothing the crawl space beneath the property which is useful for storage. Due west, the impressive, tiered garden measures 80ft in length and the boundaries are clearly defined with surrounding walls. The lower tier includes a patio, while the middle tier contains a lawn with a central pond flanked by attractive stone pathways leading to the upper tier where the lawns continue along with a shed for storage. 

This buzzing seaside town is located on the southeast coast and on the periphery of the Wicklow/Dublin border and offers the discerning purchasers a superb lifestyle with access to a wealth of amenities. Seacrest is centrally located; Bray Town Centre is 1km from the estate offering a range of shops and eateries. In addition, there are a variety of highly regarded schools at primary and secondary level to choose from along with BIFE and a number of crèches. There is no shortage of sporting facilities locally including Shoreline Leisure Centre with its swimming pool and gym, County Wicklow Lawn Tennis Club, Bray Sailing Club, Bray Divers Club, Brennanstown Horse Riding Centre and several reputable Golf Clubs. 

The renowned Seafront and Promenade is little over 500m away with its selection of popular ice cream parlours, restaurants, gastro pubs, wine bars, trendy cafes, saunas, and a playground. For the outdoor enthusiasts there is also sea swimming, the famous Bray to Greystones cliff walk and Kilruddery House & Gardens which runs a family-oriented farmers market every weekend. For commuters, the N11/M50 corridor is easily accessible along with Bray Dart Station (10-minute walk) and a 10-minute walk are frequent bus services bringing Bray folk to a host of destinations across the capital. An average Dart journey to Pearse Street takes 45 minutes. Hall - 2.17m x 3.98m

Nestled in Portmarnock—a welcoming, community-oriented suburb deeply rooted in maritime heritage and centred around the iconic Velvet Strand—this calm and inviting area makes everyday living effortlessly enjoyable. Enjoy coastal living at its finest—welcome home to Pebble Cove.

DNG Rathfarnham are delighted to present 2 Marley Lawn to the market. This impressive three-bedroom semi-detached house comes to market following an extensive upgrade and redesign to transform this lovely 1970's family home into a property that feels like it was newly built this year. 

2 Marley Lawn occupies an enviable position in the heart of the Marley Grange development, a community of similar family friendly homes that have formed one of the most sought-after housing developments in Rathfarnham. 

Positioned right opposite Marlay Park, Marley Grange features quiet cul-de-sacs, green spaces and excellent pedestrian access to Grange Road, Stonemasons Way, and Grange Manor Road with direct vehicular access via Grange Road. The local area boasts excellent amenities including a range of shopping centres nearby at Grange Road Shopping Centre, Ballinteer Shopping Centre and of course Dundrum Town Centre. There are schools at all levels within walking distance and a huge range of sports clubs, many positioned right across the road at Marlay Park which itself offers a huge range or leisure activities. Local public transport is also excellent with regular bus services passing on Grange Road and Stonemasons Way and the M50 on-ramp at Dundrum is only a two-minute drive away. 

2 Marley Lawn has just undergone an extensive renovation and refurbishment and presents as a new-build home with excellent finishes throughout. The home boasts an impressive B level energy rating thanks in part to double glazing and a brand-new gas fired central heating system and has been completely redecorated throughout. 2 Crinken Villas is a beautifully presented, charming mid-terrace two bedroom townhouse extending to approximately 95 sq.m. (1,022 sq.ft.), ideally positioned in the heart of Shankill Village.

Offering bright, well laid out accommodation over two floors, this attractive home is further enhanced by a sunny west-facing rear garden with convenient pedestrian rear access.
The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious living room featuring a bay window and fireplace, a guest wc, and a dining room which leads through to the kitchen. The kitchen provides direct access to the low-maintenance paved patio rear garden. Upstairs, there are two generous double bedrooms, both benefiting from ensuite bathrooms. The principal bedroom is situated at the back of the house with wall to wall built-in wardrobes and a full en-suite bathroom. The second bedroom to the front has a tiled en-suite shower room. The stairwell and landing which is located in the centre of the house has a cleverly designed velux skylight window which allows natural light flow down through the area.
Ideally located on Dublin Road in the heart of Shankill, 2 Crinken Villas is within easy reach of a range of shops and amenities. Shankill Village is only a short stroll away, offering a variety of cafés and restaurants including Green Beards Juicery, Camille Thai and the renowned Brady's Pub, together with a pharmacy, post office, dental practice and supermarkets including Spar, Tesco and Lidl.
The area is exceptionally well connected, with Shankill DART Station, numerous Dublin Bus routes, and easy access to the N11, M11 and M50 providing convenient links to Dublin City Centre and beyond.
Residents also benefit from an excellent selection of recreational amenities nearby, including Shanganagh Park with its children's playground and recreational playing fields, the South Dublin coastline, local sports clubs and the Dublin Mountains, all within easy reach. A wonderful opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home in the highly desirable Woodstown area. Ideally positioned overlooking a large green to the front, this property enjoys a lovely open outlook with no houses directly opposite, creating a particularly pleasant setting for family life. The green provides a safe and attractive space for children to play, while the mature surrounding residential setting makes this a hugely popular location for families.On entering, the sense of quality and care throughout the home is immediately apparent. The property has been tastefully maintained and thoughtfully upgraded over the years, offering bright, well-proportioned accommodation with a warm and welcoming feel. The generous living room opens through double glass-panelled doors into the impressive kitchen/dining room, creating a wonderful flow between the principal living spaces and allowing natural light to travel throughout the ground floor.Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious principal bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a modern en-suite, together with a family bathroom. To the rear, the property benefits from a larger-than-average private garden which is not directly overlooked, with a generous decked area, lawn, mature planting and a substantial Seomra currently used as a home office. Fully insulated and benefiting from heating and electricity, this outside room provides an exceptionally versatile additional space, suitable for working from home, a gym, playroom, studio or a variety of other uses.Outside, the front garden is bordered by a combination of red brick wall and hedging and provides off-street parking for two cars, with lawn areas to either side of the driveway and a gated side passage providing convenient access to the rear garden.Conveniently located just off the Ballycullen Road and situated at the foothills of the picturesque Dublin mountains offering the best of both worlds - village life close to the city. It is minutes from an abundance of well-established amenities such as shops at Woodstown Village and Knocklyon Shopping centre, excellent primary and secondary schools, a regular bus service (15 bus route outside the development), and easy access to the M50.This is a home that offers the ideal combination of a highly sought-after family location, well-appointed accommodation and excellent outdoor space, with the added benefit of a versatile garden room. Its position overlooking the green, generous proportions and quality of presentation make this a particularly appealing home for those seeking to settle in one of Woodstown's most popular residential settings.

GARDEN
The rear garden is larger than average and enjoys a good degree of privacy, with no direct overlooking from the rear. There is a generous decked area immediately outside the kitchen/dining room, providing an ideal space for outdoor dining and entertaining.
Beyond the decking is a lawn area with stepping stones leading to the garden room. The garden also benefits from a large timber shed, providing additional storage.
The garden room is an excellent addition to the property and is currently used as a home office. It is insulated and benefits from both heating and electricity, making it a highly versatile space which could easily adapt to suit a variety of needs, including a home office, gym, playroom, studio or hobby room. A composite front door with glazed panels allows plenty of natural light into the entrance hall. There is also a guest W.C. conveniently located off the hallway.

Living Room - 3.33m x 5.22m
A bright and comfortable reception room overlooking the green to the front. The room features ceiling coving and a fireplace with an electric log effect fire, creating a lovely focal point and adding warmth and character to the room. Double glass-panelled doors open through to the kitchen/dining room, allowing additional light to flow between the two principal living spaces.

Kitchen/Dining Room - 5.33m x 6.53m
The kitchen/dining room is a particularly impressive space, with an L-shaped kitchen layout creating a wonderful sense of space and practicality. The kitchen is fitted with solid timber countertops, a double stainless-steel sink and an excellent range of floor and eye-level units, providing an abundance of storage.The kitchen is well equipped with an integrated dishwasher, gas hob, extractor fan, Hotpoint double oven, integrated fridge freezer and integrated washing machine. A Velux roof light brings additional natural light into the room, while a radiator cover provides a neat finish.Sliding doors lead directly from the kitchen/dining room to the rear garden and decked area, creating an excellent connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces.

Principal Bedroom - 3.20m x 4.65m
A fine-sized double bedroom overlooking the front of the property and featuring built-in wardrobes, providing excellent storage. The principal bedroom also benefits from a modern en-suite shower room.

En-Suite - 1.99m x 1.84m
A modern, fully tiled en-suite shower room comprising W.C., wash hand basin with useful underneath storage, fitted mirror and light. There is also a chrome heated towel rail. The shower area features glass sliding doors and a Triton electric shower. A window provides natural light and ventilation.

Bedroom 2 - 2.68m x 4.27m
A generous double bedroom overlooking the green to the front and featuring built-in wardrobes. The room also benefits from a useful corner desk/vanity area, providing an ideal space for working, studying or getting ready.

Bedroom 3 - 2.58m x 2.74m
A well-proportioned single bedroom overlooking the front of the property. The room features a built-in wardrobe together with additional shelving, providing excellent storage.

Family Bathroom - 2.04m x 2.07m
The family bathroom is fully tiled and comprises W.C., wash hand basin with underneath storage, fitted mirror with lighting and a wall-mounted storage press. There is also a chrome heated towel rail, bath with pump shower and overhead rain shower, together with recessed lighting. Gas fired central heating Cable TV Broadband

af0056caf0.description:
No. 72A St Nessans Terrace is an attractive modern semi-detached home, built in 2018 and ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac to the rear of St Peter’s Terrace. Accessed from the top of St Nessans Terrace, the property enjoys a convenient location just above Howth Village, with the village, harbour and an array of local amenities quite literally on your doorstep.

The property also benefits from two private off-street car parking spaces, a particularly valuable feature in such a sought-after coastal location.

Extending to approximately 79 sq. m. (c. 850 sq. ft.), the well-designed accommodation is bright, contemporary and exceptionally well laid out. The ground floor is entered through a welcoming open porch and opens into a superb open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, creating a generous and versatile space for both everyday living and entertaining. A modern shower room, useful utility area and under-stairs storage complete the accommodation on this level.

The living area enjoys a wonderful connection to the outdoors through large sliding patio doors, which open directly onto the south-west facing rear garden. This sunny aspect captures the afternoon and evening sun beautifully, while the extensive glazing allows natural light to flood the interior and creates a bright, inviting atmosphere throughout the home.

Upstairs, a spacious landing benefits from high ceilings and skylights, adding further light and a sense of space. There are two generously proportioned double bedrooms, together with a further shower room.

Howth Village, with its excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, pubs, shops and local amenities, is just a few minutes' walk away. The picturesque harbour and the spectacular coastal walks for which the Howth Peninsula is renowned are also within easy reach.

For commuters, Howth DART Station is approximately a 12-minute walk away, providing convenient access to Dublin City Centre and beyond.

Built in 2018, the property benefits from modern construction standards and an air-to-water heat pump heating system, together with alu-clad windows, making this an energy-efficient and economical home to run and maintain.

Combining a superb location, modern accommodation, private parking, a sunny south-west facing garden and excellent energy efficiency, 72A St Nessans Terrace represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a contemporary home in the heart of Howth.

b17487fb70.description:
Dooley Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 3 The Dale to the market, a beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached family home extending to approximately 93 sq. m. (1,001 sq. ft.), superbly positioned within the highly regarded Brookwood development on Herbert Road, Bray.

Occupying a prime position overlooking a large central amenity green, this bright and spacious family home offers well-balanced accommodation together with a private south-westerly facing rear garden, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, growing families and those seeking a home in one of Bray's most convenient residential locations.

The well-appointed accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with guest WC, a generous front-facing living room featuring a coal-effect gas fireplace and pleasant views over the landscaped communal green. Double doors lead through to the dining room, creating an excellent flow for both everyday living and entertaining. Sliding patio doors provide direct access to the sunny rear garden, while the adjoining kitchen is fitted with an excellent range of floor and wall units, offering ample storage and workspace.

Upstairs, there are three generously proportioned bedrooms, all benefiting from built-in wardrobes. The spacious principal bedroom enjoys the added benefit of an en-suite shower room, while a well-appointed family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

The property also offers excellent potential for a substantial attic conversion, subject to the necessary planning permission, with many neighbouring homes having successfully completed similar conversions.

Externally, the property enjoys off-street parking to the front together with a neatly maintained front garden. The private rear garden benefits from a highly desirable south-westerly orientation, ensuring sunshine throughout the afternoon and evening, and provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing. Mature planting and colourful flower beds further enhance this attractive outdoor space.

Brookwood is one of Bray's most established and sought-after residential developments. The Dale is a quiet cul-de-sac comprising just twenty semi-detached and detached family homes surrounding a beautifully maintained central green. Ideally situated just off Herbert Road, residents enjoy easy access to Bray Town Centre, an excellent selection of primary and secondary schools, local shops, cafés, sporting facilities, Bray Seafront, the DART Station and Dublin Bus services. The nearby N11 and M50 provide excellent connectivity to Dublin City Centre and beyond.

Offering spacious accommodation, a superb family-friendly setting and an exceptional location, No. 3 The Dale represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a quality home in the heart of Bray.

Outside

To the front, the property benefits from a neatly maintained garden together with off-street parking. Purpose-built shallow steps provide easy access to the entrance.

The private south-westerly facing rear garden enjoys sunshine throughout the afternoon and evening, creating the perfect space for outdoor entertaining and al fresco dining. Mature planting and colourful flower beds provide year-round interest while enhancing the privacy of this attractive outdoor setting. Accommodation

32 Churchlands is a beautiful three-bedroom terraced home nestled on an elevated setting in a quiet, family friendly cul de sac. Built by well-regarded local builders, Wood Group Homes, this elegant and thoughtfully designed home offers a high standard of craftsmanship and finish throughout, with an A2 BER rating and private rear garden. Boasting stylish herringbone flooring throughout the ground floor, wall-panelling and light-filled interiors, discerning buyers will appreciate the ease of the walk-in presentation of this family home. The owners of No. 32 have also initiated the conversion of the attic by installing a staircase on the first floor, which can be further converted into a versatile and functional space should one desire. Seamlessly blending comfort and sophistication with energy efficient living, this home is sure to appeal to a wide variety of buyers. 

Extending to 105 sq m / 1,130 sq ft, this beautifully presented home offers a stylish and well-proportioned interior. Upon entering through a composite front door, one is welcomed by a bright entrance hall with herringbone flooring and access to understairs storage, a practical utility room and convenient downstairs WC. The living room to the front is a bright and inviting reception room, enhanced by stylish wall panelling and a wall-mounted TV point with a built-in electric fireplace, creating a cosy atmosphere. Towards the rear of the home is the spacious open plan kitchen / dining / living area, which is beautifully appointed and filled with natural light, benefiting from dual aspect windows overlooking the rear garden and an additional Velux window. Finished with contemporary light fittings and attractive herringbone flooring, this room is ideal for everyday family life and entertaining with a TV point installed for recreation. The kitchen is fitted with a range of eye and floor kitchen cabinetry and a comprehensive selection of integrated Electrolux appliances. Double doors open directly out to the rear garden.

Upstairs, there are three well-appointed bedrooms. The spacious principal bedroom enjoys pleasant views towards the Drummin Trees, together with extensive built-in wardrobes and a luxurious en-suite. To the rear are two further bedrooms; a generous double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a single bedroom, both overlooking the rear garden and offering flexibility for family living, guest accommodation or home working. A family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation. No. 32 also benefits from a partially converted attic room which can be accessed from a staircase on the upstairs landing.

Outside, the rear garden features a generous patio leading to a lawned area, offering ample privacy and space for outdoor recreation. Bordered by concrete walls, the garden enjoys a highly private outlook and is ideally suited to al fresco dining and entertaining. A driveway to the front provides convenient off-street parking.

Delgany is a wonderful place in which to live; not only are local village amenities to hand, such as a craft butcher, delightful deli, village market, two pubs/restaurants, and golf club among them but proximity to a choice of reputable schools at primary and secondary level, where Greystones' seafront, retail and leisure attractions are of huge appeal to local residents. As well as the Marina and an active sailing club, Greystones offers a range of sporting athletic clubs (including G.A.A., soccer, rugby and tennis) and the Shoreline Leisure Centre with indoor pool, in addition to golf, all within minutes' drive, or a decent walk from Churchlands. There is excellent connectivity, with citybound and DART feeder buses offering versatile transport options, while some of the county's favourite beauty spots, forest trails and hill-walking are near at hand.

No. 25 Woodstock is an attractive three-bedroom semi detached home, ideally positioned within this mature and well established residential development in Kilcoole. Enjoying a C1 BER, bright interiors and well-proportioned accommodation, the property is sure to appeal to first time buyers and young families alike, seeking a comfortable home within easy reach of the village, local schools, transport links and everyday amenities.

Upon entering, a welcoming entrance hall with ceiling coving and clever storage solutions sets the tone for the accommodation within. A guest wc is conveniently positioned off the hall, while the living room is located to the front of the property. The living room is a bright and inviting space, with a box bay window allowing an abundance of natural light to fill the room. An open fireplace with slate hearth and timber mantel piece provides an attractive focal point, while double doors connect the room with the kitchen and dining area beyond, allowing the ground floor to flow with ease while retaining a welcome distinction between the living spaces.
To the rear, the generous kitchen/dining room forms the heart of the home. This dual-aspect room is fitted with an extensive range of eye and floor level units, together with a selection of integrated appliances. dffb49f84f.description:
Buona Vista is one of the most impressive fully refurbished town houses ever offered for sale in the very centre of Greystones village. Following a major restoration programme, it has been transformed into a modern energy efficient low maintenance home, whilst retaining all its wonderful original character, charm and period features.

Perfectly positioned in the very heart of Greystones town centre, this beautifully presented three-bedroom Victorian townhouse offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy coastal living with every conceivable amenity quite literally on its doorstep. Just a gentle stroll from the DART station, South Beach, The Cove and the harbour, the property enjoys one of the most enviable locations in Greystones, surrounded by a wonderful selection of renowned cafés, restaurants and eateries including Chakra, The Hungry Monk, Daata, Las Tapas and Yamas, among many others. The Meridian Centre. Post Office, beauty salons, boutiques, Library, Supermarkets and much more.

Behind its attractive period façade lies a home of immense warmth and character, where elegant period features blend seamlessly with stylish contemporary finishes combining to create a highly energy efficient home having an incredible B1 BER rating. The accommodation which has been lovingly refurbished and upgraded is stunningly presented throughout, showcasing beautiful décor and a wonderful sense of light and space. Original features synonymous with the era have been lovingly retained, including impressive high ceilings adorned with decorative ceiling plasterwork, original panelled doors and an abundance of period charm. These timeless details are perfectly complemented by modern comforts including contemporary bath and shower rooms, quality kitchen fitted cabinetry, air-to-water heating and an enviable BER rating, ensuring both efficiency and comfort for modern living.
Adding further appeal are the lovely sea views and a wonderful front courtyard, providing a private and tranquil outdoor space ideal for al fresco dining, entertaining or simply relaxing. Altogether, this is a rare and highly appealing home that effortlessly combines elegance, convenience and coastal lifestyle in one of Wicklow's most sought-after seaside settings. While located in the centre of the village the house is extremely quiet due to double glazing and high levels of insulation . 

The house has been subject to a total refurbishment with the internal and external replastering of every wall and ceilings, which provided the opportunity to integrate high levels of insulation. The house has new wiring, new plumbing, new central heating, and is in walk-in condition. The house has been recently repainted and has double glazed windows and double glazed French doors. Features include, three bedrooms, kitchen, dining, living area with French doors opening towards the sea. Exceptionally wide upstairs hall with parquet flooring and high ceilings. This beautiful light filled space has been used by the owner as a home office. There are three light filled bedrooms. Other features include electronic access with a video security system providing an exceptional level of security. 
There are no management or services charges.

While located in the centre of the village the house is extremely quiet due to double glazing and high levels of insulation . The house is very private, tucked away at entrance to meridian centre and opposite the side of the village bookshop. Its location is unrivalled for convenience with access to shops, sea, park and trains and bus transportation. Just a short stroll to the beach or marina and all of Greystones' sporting amenities. These include sea swimming, sailing, fishing, kayaking, angling and rugby, soccer, GAA and golf. 

Greystones is renowned for its enviable range of sporting and leisure facilities, including swimming, angling, fishing, boating and water sports, as well as local rugby, GAA, soccer, tennis, hockey and bowling clubs. Additionally, the town boasts a library, churches of various denominations and highly regarded primary and secondary schools, many within a short walking distance. For golf enthusiasts, several exceptional courses are nearby, including Greystones, Delgany, Druids Heath, Powerscourt and Bray. Transport links are superb, with Greystones DART station, TFI bus routes and easy access to the N11/M50 network, making commuting a breeze.
